audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Vayne levels 1, 2, 3 and 6 in both layers, while the whys directly underneath say Olaf wins every one of those rows, and the packet chart and the audited Olaf side both give him levels 1 through 6.
audit.why: The page renders 'Vayne' beside text reading 'Olaf owns this window'. Ratings compound it: rows the chart hands Olaf are marked 8/10 in Vayne's favour.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 flipped to Olaf in both layers as one atomic group, with the ratings moved down with them; row 5 Skill and row 6 Vayne unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Reckless Swing is true damage, and the itemization still leans on Plated Steelcaps.
audit.why: Riot's text: Reckless Swing 'deals true damage to his target and himself' on 11/10/9/8/7s at 325 range. Stacking armour does nothing against his main burst — the answer is Grievous Wounds against Berserker Rage's missing-health lifesteal, plus spacing.
audit.corrected: Reckless Swing is true damage, so armour does not answer it — Executioner's Calling and distance do.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow's pickup reset and Tough It Out are never mentioned.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s from 1000 range, but 'if Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset' — walking over the axe is what actually denies the re-slow. Tough It Out is a 16/15/14/13/12s attack speed steroid plus shield that eats the three-hit Silver Bolts window.
audit.corrected: Walk over the axe to deny the reset; force Tough It Out's shield before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why and phases[4].why promise Vayne's pattern and Final Hour dominance on rows that belong to Olaf.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s and makes him immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, which is exactly the window Condemn's stun is being saved for.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Reckless Swing, Tough It Out and Ragnarok's immunity.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even out as Vayne nears her item spike.
edits.after: Undertow resets on pickup — the slow barely goes away.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Olaf must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is true damage on a 9s cooldown at rank 3, and Tough It Out shields your answer. Hold the wave near you.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking, so Condemn's stun does nothing — never spend it into his ult.

edits.before: AA-tumble-AA on Olaf's step-up, proc the third silver bolt for true damage, and walk away before he reaches you.
edits.after: Undertow is 9s but resets the instant he picks the axe up — walk over it and he waits the whole cooldown.

edits.before: Olaf wastes Ragnarok — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ragnarok is 100s at rank 1 — land Condemn before he casts it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ragnarok grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Ragnarok: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is true damage, so armour does nothing against it — buy Executioner's Calling instead and fight only once Tough It Out's 16s shield has been spent.

edits.before: - Olaf Ragnarok: matchup-defining — Unstoppable — you can’t peel him in it. Kite before. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ragnarok: 100s at rank 1 — disable immunity while he keeps attacking, so a Condemn stun is wasted in it. - Undertow: 9s, but picking the axe up resets it. - Tough It Out: 16s shield. - Final Hour: 100s.
